title: Adaptive milestone mesh for compliance cutovers: tenant auditlog retention, SSO canary gating, and blackout windows
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description:
Background:
Redwood needs a repeatable, low-friction way to orchestrate cross-functional compliance cutovers (SOC2/ISO, SSO/SAML changes, tenant-scoped auditlog retention) across multiple cycles and customers. Past cutovers exposed brittle coordination (misaligned blackout windows, unclear gate ownership, and ad-hoc evidence bundling).

Goal:
Design and deliver an 'adaptive milestone mesh'—a lightweight orchestration pattern and artifact bundle that maps milestone owners, blackout windows, canary gating steps, evidence buckets, and rollback criteria so cutovers are predictable, auditable, and minimally disruptive to customers. The mesh should be consumable by Console runbooks, oncall, and the release manager.

Success criteria (measurable):
- No more than one customer-facing incident during any compliance cutover across next three cycles.
- All cutover milestones have an assigned owner and automated checklist in Console runbook before go/no-go call.
- Evidence bundle exports (Confluence + artifact links) produced within 48 hours of cutover completion for audit reviewers.
- Tenant auditlog retention toggle tested in canary group that represents at least 5% of active tenants before broad rollout.

Scope / Deliverables:
1) Milestone mesh template: JSON + human-readable matrix that lists milestone ID, owner, acceptance criteria, evidence link, rollback signal, and blackout window (start/end).
2) Canary gating runbook: how to pick tenant cohort, metrics to monitor (error rate, auth failures, API latency, SLO delta), threshold signals, and automated rollback hooks.
3) Console runbook integration: create a runbook template and a short UX for owners to mark milestones as green/amber/red and attach evidence links.
4) Evidence bundler: a small workflow that compiles audit artifacts (logs retention configs, SSO SAML exchange captures, test vectors, PR links) into a zipped package and posts to the Confluence evidence page.
5) Oncall playbook and postmortem template tailored to compliance cutovers.

Out-of-scope for this ticket:
- Implementing new low-level KV logging storage changes (ENG-42711) — that’s a dependency.
- Tenant billing adjustments for retention changes — will be handled by Billing PMs separately.

Acceptance criteria (for marking Done):
- Mesh template reviewed and approved by Security & Compliance and SRE.
- Console runbook prototype implemented and tested in staging with at least 1 simulated cutover.
- Canary gating executed end-to-end for tenant auditlog retention with metrics captured in Grafana.
- Evidence bundler produces a Confluence-ready archive and a short checklist for auditors.

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: Canary cohort not representative -> Mitigation: use traffic-weighted sampling + manual vetting by Solutions Eng.
- Risk: Owners miss blackout windows -> Mitigation: automatic calendar invites + 48-hour pre-cutover reminders via Slack and Console notifications.
- Risk: Evidence incomplete under time pressure -> Mitigation: automatic artifact collection scripts and mandatory pre-cutover artifact checklist in runbook.
